title: SmartSynth: Domain-Agnostic Synthetic Data Generator
summary: SmartSynth is a multi-domain synthetic data generation framework with CLI and Streamlit UI that produces tabular, time-series, text, and image synthetic data alongside privacy and quality evaluation tools. Its tabular generators are built directly on SDV, wrapping sdv.single_table's CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, and CopulaGANSynthesizer plus SingleTableMetadata and evaluation plotting utilities as the core tabular synthesis engine.
